title: Give OLY-10-02 a mechanism whose evaluated stage needs real evaluation
summary: Retry of job 20261029-233058-fveq: add a tested improvement-cycle check in athena-data, shown in `athena status`, and record it as the OLY-10-02 mechanism and measure. Unlike the rejected attempt, "evaluated candidate" counts only when a recorded evaluation result (method_experiment-style baseline vs candidate) exists, and the finding links to the proposal. The goal is for Athena's owner to see whether the final acceptance chain is shown, without the line claiming success on real data where nothing was evaluated.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check that the evaluated stage distinguishes true from false, not just that the line exists.
An empty record set is not shown, covered by a test.
Unit and display tests, plus fmt, clippy and test.
Behavior criteria name cargo test commands the verifier can run.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/proposals.rs (REPEAT_THRESHOLD = 3, proposals need 3 distinct jobs, so a jobs.len()>=2 filter is true for every real proposal), crates/athena-core/src/method_experiment.rs and role_value.rs (baseline-versus-candidate compare gives a verdict), crates/athena-data/src/records.rs (AnyRecord at line 1076, check_record_file at line 1402 is the allow-list and round-trip entry), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (StatusView and its builder) and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs. The check is a pure function over already-loaded records; status builds it from landed jobs and display prints one line.

Job 20261029-233058-fveq: kept from its candidate: the improvement_cycle pure check, the status line, the spec.toml edit, the CHANGELOG entry and the status.rs plumbing. Fixed: (a) the evaluated stage no longer uses jobs.len()>=2; it uses a recorded evaluation result for that candidate, with the field named in code; (b) the finding is linked to the proposal by introspection id or failure class; (c) the status.rs doc comment is put back on build_measurement_line. The two extra files (status.rs, status_build_measurement.rs) are now listed as deliverables.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/method_experiment.rs, crates/athena-core/src/proposals.rs, crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs. The job reuses or extends these and creates none of them.

If no evaluation record type exists in the records, the producer reuses the existing method_experiment result shape rather than adding a new record type. If a new type is added, it goes in the AnyRecord/check_record_file allow-list with a round-trip test.

On today's real records the likely honest result is `status: not shown`, since no candidate has a recorded evaluation. That is acceptable only if the measure says so and the replay test shows both outcomes on fixtures.
Goal and audience: Athena's owner reading `athena status` and the spec measure.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-10-02 has a mechanism naming an existing crates/ path and function (not "none"), owner Athena kept, and a measure ending in `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` plus the test name. Check by Grep on docs/spec.toml and on the named function in crates/.

In crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs, fn improvement_cycle no longer contains a `jobs.len() >= 2`-style filter for the evaluated stage. A code comment names the record field used as the evaluation signal. Check with Grep for the removed filter and the comment.

Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection`. Tests with fixtures shaped like real records show: a proposal with no evaluation record is not counted as evaluated; one with an evaluation record is; a finding about a different failure class or introspection than the proposal does not complete the chain; and a set missing any one stage reports that stage missing. The tests fail if the check always returns shown or always missing.
An empty record set reports not shown, never success (no-empty-success). A test in `cargo test -p athena-data introspection` covers it.

A test replays the check over a fixture mixing evaluated and unevaluated proposals, with the proposals built like real ones (3 distinct source jobs). It asserts both outcomes occur and that the stage is neither true for all nor false for all. Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection`.

`athena status` prints the `improvement cycle:` line, and display tests assert it for both shown and `not shown (missing: ...)`, with the unevaluated case naming the evaluation stage. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli` and `cargo test -p athena-core status`. All existing tests that read status output still pass.
In crates/athena-core/src/status.rs the doc comment sits on the function it describes: build_measurement_line keeps its own rustdoc and improvement_cycle_line has its own. Check with git diff.

Any new record or data type is covered by the allow-list and round-trip test (check_record_file/AnyRecord in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs), or no new record type is added. Check by Grep and git diff.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the OLY-10-02 improvement-cycle check. Check with git diff.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`. All pass.

out_of_scope: Running a real end-to-end demonstration with a live defect
Generic enforcement of a replay check for all status measures (the prevention already tried for OLY-9-11)
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference: this is a retry that touches the data, core and CLI crates, and needs a design for the evaluation signal.
